propositions: Network-capable git calls in gerrit_client.clone_change_ref and workspace._git lack timeout bounds and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers.
TimeoutExpired exceptions from unbounded git calls bypass exception handlers and expose credential tokens in error messages, creating both security and reliability defects.
gerrit_client and workspace modules require module-level _GIT_TIMEOUT = 300 matching the 747f cold-clone precedent, and all subprocess.run invocations must pass timeout as a kwarg.
timeout exceptions must be converted to module-appropriate exception types (GerritError, WorkspaceError) naming the operation and bound, with credentials redacted via existing token-scrubbing paths.
_ref_lock.py is already structurally bounded by a required timeout parameter on its single _git seam and requires no edit.
Two deferred call sites (init.py fetch and fsck_repair.py push) are blocked on task 983f and linked for later handling.
